import math

# Values in millions
beginning_value = 2289997
ending_value = 4764858

# Number of years
n = 10

# CAGR formula
cagr = (ending_value / beginning_value) ** (1/n) - 1
cagr_percentage = cagr * 100

print(f'Beginning value (June 2003): {beginning_value:,} million')
print(f'Ending value (June 2013): {ending_value:,} million')
print(f'Ratio: {ending_value / beginning_value:.6f}')
print(f'CAGR: {cagr:.6f}')
print(f'CAGR (%): {cagr_percentage:.4f}%')
print(f'Rounded to nearest hundredths: {round(cagr_percentage, 2)}%')
"
